extractCallbackBody (anonymous visitor: added FQCN-aware currentClass tracking + exact-equality class match — P1 fix, two-round review)
files_modified.behavior_before: Phase 3 ran SourceSinkVisitor only on the direct callback body. Sinks in methods called via $this->method() were invisible — IR had source but no sink for delegated patterns.
files_modified.behavior_after: After SSV traversal of callback body, resolveCallChain() is called when callback has a class context. For each $this->method() call found: looks up method via SymbolTable::findMethod(), parses its body, runs SSV with inherited entry_point_id, recurses up to depth=2 with cycle detection via $visited[]. extractCallbackBody() now tracks the current Class_ node using the namespacedName attribute (same FQCN pattern as SymbolTable and EntryPointVisitor) and requires exact FQCN equality before matching a ClassMethod — prevents wrong-class-same-name false match in both non-namespaced and namespaced multi-class files.

post_review_fix.issue: P1 — extractCallbackBody() matched ClassMethod by name only, ignoring class context. In a file with multiple classes sharing a helper name (with or without namespaces), resolveCallChain() could resolve the wrong class body.
post_review_fix.fix_description: Anonymous visitor in extractCallbackBody() now derives currentClass from Class_ node using isset($node->namespacedName) ? $node->namespacedName->toString() : $node->name->toString() — identical to the pattern in SymbolTable (line 125-126) and EntryPointVisitor (line 76-77). ClassMethod match uses exact string equality (currentClass === $this->class). Both sides are FQCN when NameResolver has run. leaveNode resets currentClass to null on Class_ exit.
post_review_fix.post_review_1_error: First fix used $node->name->toString() (short name) and str_ends_with() fallback. str_ends_with('A\\Worker', 'Worker') = true and str_ends_with('B\\Worker', 'Worker') = true — namespace collision still possible.
post_review_fix.verified_by: Three fixtures all pass: call-chain-test (depth-1, depth-2 SQL sinks correct ep), multi-class-test (non-namespace: SQL→entry-point, echo→file-level), namespace-collision-test (A\Worker echo file-level, B\Worker SQL→entry-point). Benchmark backwpup QS=1.0 FP=0 no regression.
